simulation: Production manifest, loader-owned WebP atlas, and athleteBallTracks.kraken.layup-reverse; actual Jam Stage stepMatch executes the calibrated track, tick12 release, shot flight, score and celebration. The browser harness exposes the production image map for assertions and recenters only the review camera before screenshots; no candidate atlas, manifest, or track is injected.
grid: Post-release trajectory checkpoints plus score/dead-ball completion for both facings × 100%/120%
captureMethod: For each facing, the match starts with Kraken on the selected offensive roster (home for right, away for left) so the production renderer resolves him from the matching team roster. A one-time diagnostic fixture keeps only that real Kraken player in frame and initializes the production layup-reverse shot action. Production stepMatch advances animation, takeoff, carried-ball track, release, shot physics, rim/score resolution, and completion continuously. No manual per-tick ball teleporting; no pause overlay; no ball baked into art.
fixture: Fresh match per facing/zoom; after 100 neutral production ticks with Kraken holding the ball at the attacking rim, the camera follows normally and the action begins. The production stepMatch path runs until score/ball completion.
setupFixture: Real production manifest/track and loader image are used. The diagnostic fixture starts Kraken on the scoring roster at x150/50,courtY80; production stepMatch runs until score/ball completion.

productionTrack.status: candidate calibration only; no runtime changes
productionTrack.calibrationNote: Compared with attempt24, frame5 forward moves from -5 to -2.5 to bring the ball through the raised behind-head hand at release. All other sampled values are retained. Tick12 release and made two-point score are preserved in both facings.
